notes.title: Keyboard & Mouse Added
notes.content:
(Aug 23) Keyboard and mouse have been added. However, please note that it does not have key remapping.

[b]Key Bindings[/b]
W, A, S, D: Move
Left click: Light attack
Right click: Heavy attack
Wheel & F: Target
1, 2: Skill
E: Interact
Shift: Guard
Space: Dodge
V: Swap weapon
C: Parry and counter attack
G: Restore health


Thank you.

If you haven't wishlisted, please do below!
